name: Castel Guelfo The Style Outlets
note: Outlet centre about 20 minutes from Bologna, operated by NEINVER; club business partner since 2024. On the front right chest of the 2026/27 black LBA home jersey per the club store's product photo. Left unrated: the ownership chain stops at NEINVER and no checked source names who owns it; NEINVER's own site describes it as a family business founded in Spain by José María Losantos (neinver.com/who-we-are-3), which points at the Losantos family but does not state who owns the company today.
